tasks.goal: Guide visitors along the Charter Hall exhibit walls, gesturing at each charter panel and delivering the contribution-model narration.
tasks.terrain: Polished exhibition-hall floors near the Bibliotheca Alexandrina; avoid glass display cases and cabling along walls.
success: Visits all 5 exhibit waypoints in order
Speech phrase log complete for each stop
safety_stops: Halt speech if crowd density >4 persons within 2 m
tasks.human_in_loop: A docent approves the narration script and starts/stops each public tour session.

tasks.goal: Fetch labeled research binders from shelf slots and deliver them to the synthesis desk for the Evidence Monitor agents.
tasks.terrain: Carpeted lab aisles 1.2 m wide; shelf lips at 0.9-1.4 m height; avoid rolling chairs and cable trays.
success: Places each within 5 cm of desk target
safety_stops: Stop arm if human within 0.7 m of workspace
Abort pick on grasp force >30 N
tasks.human_in_loop: A librarian confirms the binder list and acknowledges each delivery at the desk.

tasks.goal: Carry a wireless microphone dock between speaker stations in the tiered forum during proposal debate sessions.
tasks.terrain: Tiered seating with steps; operate on flat central floor only; avoid podium stairs and trailing AV cables.
safety_stops: Stop at detected step edge <0.3 m
tasks.human_in_loop: The forum moderator approves station order and can recall the robot mid-session.

tasks.goal: Patrol the Operations Deck perimeter, inspecting cable runs and rack doors with the onboard camera for task-routing crews.
tasks.terrain: Concrete deck floor with ramp transitions near the harbor-side conference center; avoid equipment racks and pallets.
tasks.human_in_loop: An operations lead reviews flagged images and authorizes each patrol route.

tasks.goal: Fly a repeating scan of the Progress Observatory display wall to capture meter dashboards for archive imagery.
tasks.terrain: Indoor airspace under 4 m ceiling; avoid hanging lights, banners, and wall-mounted display arms; no outdoor wind exposure.
success: Completes 3 scan loops at 2.5 m altitude
Holds position within 10 cm of waypoints
safety_stops: Land if human enters flight volume
tasks.human_in_loop: An observatory steward authorizes each flight window and confirms the airspace is clear.

tasks.goal: Climb the stepped seating of the adjacent planetarium lecture space to inspect row lighting and seat-mounted sensors after hours.
tasks.terrain: Stepped concrete rows (rise ~0.3 m), handrails, dark after-hours lighting; avoid the projection dome equipment.
success: Maintains 3 foot contacts per step transition
Captures sensor images from each row
safety_stops: Auto-stop if any foot slips >5 cm
tasks.human_in_loop: Facilities staff schedule the after-hours window and clear the seating before the run.

tasks.goal: Sort returned exhibition catalogs from a return bin into labeled shelf slots at the entry kiosk.
tasks.terrain: Fixed kiosk beside entry turnstiles; smooth counter surface; shelf slots at 0.6-1.8 m; avoid visitor queue lane.
safety_stops: Stop arm if visitor enters kiosk zone
tasks.human_in_loop: A kiosk attendant opens/closes the sorting session and resolves mis-sorted items.

tasks.goal: Assemble a small demonstration model of the library disc facade for public display, placing numbered acrylic segments on a peg board.
tasks.terrain: Demonstration table under the observatory mezzanine; segment trays and peg board; keep clear of railing edge and visitors leaning in.
safety_stops: Reflex stop on contact force >15 N
Stop if hand detected in workspace
Pause on Cartesian velocity limit breach
tasks.human_in_loop: An exhibit curator approves the finished assembly for public display and may pause at any time.
